title: Tim and the Big Box
lines: "Can I have the big box?" said Tim.
"Yes," said Dad. "It can be a den."
Tim set it on the rug. A cat den!
But the cat did not get in the box.
The cat sat on top and had a nap.
Tim set his red hat in the box.
The cat hops in and naps on the hat.
"The cat has a den," said Dad. Tim nods.

questions.ask: What did Tim want the big box for?
questions.listenFor: To make a den for his cat. Line three says it. If your child is stuck, let them reread that line.

questions.ask: What did Tim put in the box to get the cat to go in?
questions.listenFor: His red hat. Line six says it. One word is plenty.

questions.ask: Why do you think the hat worked? Tell me what you think.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. You are listening for a reason of their own, like it was soft, or it smelled of Tim.
